SELECT c.customer_id, c.country, c.email_hash, COUNT(o.order_id) AS lifetime_orders, SUM(o.amount) AS lifetime_value, COALESCE(s.total_sessions,0) AS total_sessions FROM silver.customers c LEFT JOIN silver.orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) total_sessions FROM silver.sessions GROUP BY 1) s ON s.user_id = CAST(c.customer_id AS STRING) GROUP BY 1,2,3,6
